job: check recovery sources and tracked pushed recipe files declared by list rows before moving eligible unchanged local paths to recoverable native Trash

targets.role: List recovery-availability, recipe, confinement and quiet-age eligibility plus a native Trash caller; no new OS disposal, Namespace-copy, permission or storage mechanism.

preserve: The existing native Trash operation and its recoverability; no permanent-delete fallback or Trash emptying.
Dry run by default, per-row eligibility separate from disposal, and list writeback owned by the caller.
Availability answers and tracked/pushed recipes are not recovery-byte proofs; observed path allocation is not measured physical disk space reclaimed.
A denied contained move retains the source and returns no successful next_value; no wider grant is introduced.
Unavailable Git observations remain unreadable rather than proving outside-Git, untracked or unchanged; inherited Git environment selectors cannot redirect the proof reads.
allowed_deltas: Adopt and repair the stopped uncommitted prototype while preserving its original bytes as authorship/recovery evidence only.
Retain the list eligibility checks and use the existing native Trash API through a narrow caller rather than implement a disposal engine.
Refuse failed repository discovery, tracking, recipe-status or upstream reads; keep those observations distinct from an established outside-Git path and scope Git reads to the selected repository.
banned_substitutions: Calling an uncommitted prototype blob a committed or published source-only copy baseline.
Claiming native Trash, verified Namespace-copy disposal or generic record deletion has no prior owner.
Converting source availability into a byte-recovery proof, or reporting a Trash move as measured disk space freed.
Broadening the sandbox grant, falling back to permanent deletion, or presenting uncontained synthetic tests as contained customer proof.

baseline.scope: No source-first copy baseline is claimed. The stopped prototype was uncommitted and its original authorship is unverified.

prototype_recovery.qualification: Preserved uncommitted source bytes, not a published original, source-only commit, or proof of authorship.
